id: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze (1991)

facts.text: Bring out the snacks when the Turtles start the rap in the club.
facts.why: Vanilla Ice is the performer at the club, and Raphael is thrown in mid-song during the fight. The turtles do not start the rap. The same cue is printed on the phone page.
facts.fix: Bring out the snacks when Vanilla Ice raps in the club and the fight spills in.

facts.text: the turtles' rule on pizza that turns up late
facts.why: I found no turtles' rule about late pizza in the film.
facts.fix: the pizza Keno delivers, on time or not

vibe.verdict: Bright, busy pizzeria sheet with Keno and the ooze canister, but it leaves out the club and the big baddies.
missing: Vanilla Ice's Ninja Rap at the club
Doughnuts used to feed the antidote to Tokka and Rahzar
Super Shredder after drinking the last ooze
The abandoned City Hall subway station lair
ideas: Swap 'Pizza bagels' for 'Antidote doughnuts, one each'.
Replace the 'Canned soda' note with 'Ninja Rap, live on Friday'.
Add a Super Shredder size chart to the 'No delivery' warning.
